lastCompletedStory.title: Migrate project.toml, docs, templates and CHANGELOG none->local

openQuestions: All 4 stories of CAM-236 (US-001 through US-004) now pass. The PRD is complete pending review.

Ship gotcha carried over from US-004's own notes: the currently-INSTALLED cam binary (pre-this-PR) still compares === 'none' internally, so this PR's own `cam ship --finalize` may read 'local' from the now-migrated project.toml and skip the local issue-file close for CAM-236 -- the operator/orchestrator may need to close the issue file manually or rebuild+reinstall the binary before shipping this PRD.

Two remaining 'none' mentions were deliberately left out of AC scope for US-004 (documented as a new patterns.md bullet this story): `.claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md:72` (`issue_system = none` in an edge-case checklist bullet) and `scripts/cam/patterns.md:46` (the finalizeCycleClose hardening bullet, itself a knowledge doc not a code path). A future small docs-sweep story should close both for full consistency, though neither is a code path or blocks anything functionally.

scripts/build-release.sh AC4 smoke still passes '--issue-system none' to the compiled binary (carried over from US-001/US-002/US-003; still out of scope -- no story in CAM-236 touched build-release.sh).
nextStoryContext: CAM-236 (issue_system none -> local rename) is now fully implemented across all 4 stories: US-001 (enum + setup prompts), US-002 (central readIssueSystem reader wired into ship-finalize + ship-pr, noisy-throw on legacy 'none'), US-003 (issue-list wired + test-fixture sweep), US-004 (project.toml + cam-issue.md dual-copy + subagent-orchestrator.md dual-copy + recovery-runbook.md + CHANGELOG breaking-rename note, vendor re-embedded). No production code, test, or template/doc string literal 'none' referring to issue_system remains except: (a) the CHANGELOG breaking-rename note (intentional, the only surviving historical mention), (b) test/config/issue-system.test.ts's deliberate 'throws on legacy none' negative-case test (also intentional, proves the noisy-fail behavior), and (c) the two out-of-AC-scope docs mentions listed in openQuestions. If the next PRD includes a follow-up docs-consistency story, point it at those two files directly instead of re-deriving scope from a fresh grep sweep.
